purpose: Prospective additional DEVELOPMENT validation of the frozen retained-method real-observation adapter. Not final-test unlocking, independent reviewer or physical gold.

comparison: Same native power sequence for original CPOP/LABS and adapted retained chain; CPOP structural curve shared exactly. Map positions to original seconds, no resampling/filling. Same prior scoring policy180s missing penalty; no effective0.15kW or fault truth claimed.
scope: No test/external observation reading, original data edits, old-model replacement, production adoption, prediction, report, second-block changes or new dependency.
